parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter.

id.description: Unique identifier of the template reference.

plan_template_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the template item this reference is attached to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the reference was created. ISO 8601 format.

payload.description: Contains type-specific attributes. For company templates, only the attachment type is supported.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

type.description: Type of reference attached to the template item. Company templates only support 'attachment'.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the reference was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
